release_notes: v0.5.0-rc12: Risk Level labels now follow the confirmed violation severity instead of the numeric risk score alone. A call shows Critical only when at least one confirmed Critical-severity violation exists, so High-only or Medium-only findings with a high score no longer read as Critical on the call detail page, in Processed Calls, in search and customer search, in both Excel exports, or in the cloud risk level. Calls with no violations stay Low and unflagged. Updates in place; no data-model change and no migration — RC11 records remain readable. Prerelease build for controlled RC validation.
